title: Gregory Barbaccia PLTR holding and ethics status
summary: The disclosed PLTR range falls within a watchdog-described criminal-conflict exemption, while public disposition, screening and participation records remain unresolved.

sources.title: Stephen Miller’s Financial Stake in ICE Contractor Palantir
Gold Rush:Top Trump Officials’ Silicon Valley Ties

value.disclosed_asset: Palantir Technologies Class A Common Stock (PLTR)
value.criminal_conflict_nuance: POGO reported that holdings in this value range are low enough to fall under a regulatory exemption from the criminal conflict-of-interest prohibition.
value.separate_reported_divestment: POGO later reported Barbaccia divested an Anduril stake; that report does not establish PLTR divestment.
value.interpretation: The small holding weakens a criminal-conflict theory but does not resolve appearance, screening, recusal, participation or subsequent disposition questions.

data.method: Financial-disclosure index and targeted ethics-record review

caveats: Absence from the indexed public record is not proof that no nonpublic ethics instruction or later transaction exists.
